cd /workspace && cat > tests/memcheck.py << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, pathlib, random, resource
def make(asize=24, natoms=8, seed=3):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    toks = ['t%d' % i for i in range(asize)]
    atoms=[]; seen=set()
    while len(atoms) < natoms:
        p = tuple(rng.choice(toks) for _ in range(16))
        if p not in seen: seen.add(p); atoms.append(p)
    return {'services': toks,
            'rules': [{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'and', 'args': [{'op': 'contains', 'path': list(p)} for p in atoms]}}],
            'queries': [[toks[j % asize] for j in range(4096)] for _ in range(4)]}
lines = [json.dumps(make(seed=s)).encode() for s in (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], cwd=cwd,
                       input=b''.join(l + b'\n' for l in lines), capture_output=True)
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('rc', r.returncode, 'out bytes', len(r.stdout), 'child max RSS MB %.1f' % (ru.ru_maxrss / 1024))
outs = [json.loads(x) for x in r.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
print('states per line', [len(o['dfa']['next']) for o in outs])
print('total output MB %.1f' % (len(r.stdout) / 1048576))
EOF
